basis: Random grid scan of the sea between the four live hot spots (decision 2026-10-30, user). Each round visits every tile of hotspot-tests/grid.json once in random order. A tile gets one random scene; if that scene finds no pair it gets a second scene on another date; a pair on the first ends the visit.

first_dates_per_day.basis: User decision 2026-10-30: 25 random tiles a day get their first scene.

max_scans_per_day.basis: User decision 2026-10-30: at most 50 scenes queued per UTC day, first and second dates together; second dates are queued before new first dates.

dates_per_tile.basis: User decision 2026-10-30: a second date is taken only when the first finds no pair.

window_days.basis: User decision 2026-10-30: scenes are drawn at random from the last 30 days.

window_max_days.basis: User decision 2026-10-30: when the 30-day window holds no usable scene the window widens to 60 days and no further.

source_order.basis: S1 first: the live sites give 3.7 to 6.1 pairs per S1 scene against 1.0 to 1.65 per S2 scene (docs/feasibility.md, predicting pair locations), so one empty S1 scene is far stronger evidence than one empty S2 scene. S2 is used when a tile has no usable S1 scene in the window. S2 cloud limit is scene.s2_max_cloud_pct in sts_graph.json.

hit_verdicts.basis: Run verdicts of the scene that count as a pair for the visit decision. These are automatic labels: a hit marks the tile a candidate for review, not a confirmed pair (run 91 was a haze false pair).

min_hulls_for_second_date.note: A first scene below this many checked hulls would close the tile as quiet without a second date. Left null until the hull counts of the first scenes show where to cut.

min_shore_distance_m.basis: Same shore mask as every hot spot and test area (decision 2026-10-19).

result_wait_days.basis: A queued scene with no review result after this many days is reported as stuck in the status output; it is not retried automatically.
